data.name: YoursHeading
data.comment: Heading of the card on a dictionary page that holds what you have of the name, how its cuttings went and your own note.

data.name: NoteLabel
data.comment: Small heading over your own note on a dictionary page.

data.name: NoteAdd
data.comment: Button on a dictionary page that opens the box for your own note on a name.

data.name: NotePlaceholder
data.value: For example: mine like it tight
data.comment: Hint in the empty box for a note on a name.

data.name: NoteHint
data.value: Shows under the name on your plants of this name.
data.comment: Line under the box for a note on a genus, species or cultivar.

data.name: NoteAria
data.comment: Screen reader name of the note box. {0} is the name, like Monstera deliciosa.

data.name: NoteError
data.value: The note could not be saved.
data.comment: Shown when saving a note on a name fails.

data.name: Empty
data.value: You have nothing of this yet. What you add shows up here with how its cuttings went. A note you write stays with the name.
data.comment: Line in the card on a dictionary page when you have no plants, cuttings or wishes of that name.

data.name: HadHeading
data.comment: Small heading over the plants that died or went to someone else and the cuttings that are finished, in the card on a dictionary page.

data.name: ResultsHeading
data.comment: Small heading over the success rate per medium in the card on a dictionary page.

data.name: ResultsLink
data.comment: Link under the cuttings results on a dictionary page to the results of all cuttings.

data.name: LineGenus
data.comment: Label before your note on the genus, under a plant's name.

data.name: LineSpecies
data.comment: Label before your note on the species, under a plant's name.

data.name: LineCultivar
data.comment: Label before your note on the cultivar, under a plant's name.

data.name: Line
data.comment: One line under a plant's name. {0} is the label like Genus note, {1} is the start of the note.
